{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01ER87evZBuJC5bRofAtcQ3Q","type":"tool_result","content":"50\t * - TENANT_ADMIN: Single tenant, full tenant access\n51\t * - MODULE_MANAGER: Single tenant + assigned modules, full module access\n52\t * - MODULE_USER: Single tenant + assigned modules, limited access\n53\t */\n54\t@ObjectType()\n55\t// AUTHENTICATED user type — returned ONLY by auth's own self/admin queries\n56\t// (currentUser, tenantUsers, login/register payloads). email/role/tenantId are\n57\t// safe here because `User` is NOT a federation join point anymore: cross-subgraph\n58\t// references (messaging `Message.sender`, `ChannelMember.user`, userPresence) use\n59\t// the display-only `PublicUserProfile` (public-user-profile.type.ts), which\n60\t// structurally omits email. So `email` below stays non-null and can never resolve\n61\t// to null over a federated reference. The `@key` + reference resolver moved to\n62\t// PublicUserProfile (PublicUserProfileFederationResolver).
